svg.title: Гиперэкстензия с акцентом на бицепс бедра — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. A true 45-degree Roman-chair hip extension using upper-thigh pad and anchored heel rollers. Side three-quarter view. Athlete faces floor, feet held under rollers at lower end, upper thighs braced on pad just below hip crease. Left: fold forward from hips with upper body downward, knees only slightly soft, torso neutral, arms crossed on chest. Right: raise torso until shoulders, hips and ankles make one straight diagonal line, without arching back above the line. Pad and feet remain fixed. Show feet anchored and no weight in hands. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
